Pass the PAUSE Act. Now.

Time to redraw some maps. 

Great news from SCOTUS striking down Louisiana’s racially gerrymandered map, 6–3.

I’ve spent years challenging flawed applications of the Voting Rights Act.

We are in a war for our way of life. We must recognize it.

Ted Cruz (@tedcruz)

Incredibly sad news. Chad was one of the greatest voices in Texas, and his loss will be deeply felt throughout the state.

For over 20 years, Chad was the voice of Lubbock, Texas, keeping Texans up to date on the most important issues. Gone far too soon, he will be missed.
